correctness.rationale: Using pinned 10 vertices and Higashitani’s 10 primitive facet normals, independently enumerated all facet incidences and 18 two-dimensional normal cones symbolically for every integer h≥2. Every cross-product gcd is 1 except pairs (1,4),(7,8), each index 4. Their dual polytope edges u1–u9 and u4–u8 have primitive length 1 and are disjoint; they define exactly two singular P1 lines of projective degree 1. The saturated two-ray transverse cone has integral coordinates (1,0),(1,4), and its dual semigroup Hilbert basis gives UV=W^4 (A3). Six other maximal cones are unimodular; four nonsimplicial endpoints give torsion-free local class groups Z,Z²,Z,Z² by unimodular minors. Symbolic incidence verification establishes the h-uniform fan assertions; Higashitani’s published facet and very-ampleness statements remain cited hypotheses.
